evidence_excerpts: The transformed back-annotation data include WCET for the entire program, functions, and basic blocks; WCEP membership; worst-case execution frequency per CFG edge; execution feasibility; I-cache misses per basic block; code size; and spill-code amount.
text: WCC’s back-annotation raises assembly-level WCET information to source-level ICD-C structures, enabling source-level optimizations to use WCET, WCEP membership, execution frequencies, cache misses, code size, and spill-code data.
